# Language Features: Functions

Declaring functions and jumping to labels with Goto and Gosub.

Functions are declared at the top level of a program. `Goto` and `Gosub` jump to a label, which is a name after a dot (`.again`).

Back to [Language Features](Language-Features) or the [Command Index](Command-Index).
